sections.heading: Indefinite Conjugation Basics
paragraphs: In Hungarian, indefinite conjugation is used when the object is unknown, general, or not specifically defined.
Many routine verbs that describe daily actions use indefinite conjugation when there is no definite object.

sections.heading: Daily Routine Examples
paragraphs: Here are simple sentences using indefinite conjugation:
"Délelőtt tanulok." – "I study in the late morning."
